transcript.dialogue: I’m Mira. Watch out for the cuffs, I always manage to get ink on the cream here. What brings you to a corner that's about to be swept into the air?
I'm Dex. It's nice to meet you, Mira. I usually prefer places that are already quiet, but this isn't so bad. What kind of ink are you always getting on things?
Oh, just drafting fluid mostly. I map streets that sort of... migrate. You smell like a kiln, by the way. Do you throw pots or sculpt?
transcript.action: draws a tiny spiral on a napkin

transcript.dialogue: I throw pots. Mostly vases that end up slightly lopsided. Streets that migrate sounds like a lot of paperwork.
At least lopsided has character. And paper is just stubborn terrain. See, if you fold this corner over, the kiln moves three blocks east.
That is a very fast way to zone a neighborhood. I used to be a stunt double, so I'm used to things moving faster than they should.
A stunt double? Well, that explains the fiery entrance you just avoided. But honestly, if your life keeps catching fire, you need a better atlas. Here, look, contour lines don't lie.
transcript.action: sketches a quick map on a napkin

transcript.dialogue: If my life had contour lines, they'd all be bunched up near the ovens. It's really nice meeting you, Mira. We should grab coffee as friends sometime.
transcript.action: steps out into the cool air

transcript.dialogue: I'd like that, Dex. I usually spend Tuesdays trying to find a bakery that moved, so coffee as friends sounds much more grounded.
Grounded is good. Have a safe walk home.
